reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: Every day I have to fight fraud in this evil world, and Masterclass just stole $350 from my bank account. I thought I was paying $10 monthly. I haven’t even watched 1 video yet in the 4-5 days I’ve signed up for. I checked my account this morning and I’ve been hoodwinked. I’m so tired of all the evil in this world. Especially when it’s disguised as education. I’m fighting this through my bank. So help me god

reviews.title: Membership scam
reviews.text: This company is such a scam. I canceled my account last year but because I didn’t remove my payment method they auto renewed me and charged me $180. On the same day I reached out to customer service for a refund but they refused. They acknowledged that my account had been cancelled but since my payment method was still there they wouldn’t give me my money back. I hardly used the account the few years I had it this whole thing is a waste of money.

reviews.title: Will auto renew despite canceling
reviews.text: Customer service is AI. I asked to not renew and it renewed anyway and charged me $200. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: Cost too steep from the start
reviews.text: Too high a monetary barrier of entry and commitment.

reviews.title: Avoid!!!!
reviews.text: The content is fine. The app is horrible on almost all fronts and good luck getting anyone to talk to you or answer email.  Borderline scam if it weren’t for the legitimate speakers they have.

reviews.title: Unable to log in with Google for a week now
reviews.text:
I have been unable to access the app for a week. Every time I try to sign in with my Google account, I get the message "Unable to log in – MasterClass was unable to log you in through Google. Please try again later."

I have tried repeatedly, on different days, and the error persists. I restarted my device, reinstalled the app, and confirmed that my internet connection works without issues, but nothing has helped.

This leaves me without access to a service I am entitled to use, with no explanation and no alternative. I ask the team to fix this bug urgently, as an authentication problem lasting a week is unacceptable.

I will gladly revise this review once a fix is released.

reviews.title: Fraudulent and misleading
reviews.text: I purchased annual subscription on 8/31 and then cancelled my subscription in September since I did not want to auto-renew. The email TOLD me I can continue to access the content I paid for but one month later I can no longer access. Today, there was a screen in the app telling me I can renew my subscription at no additional cost. I pressed the button and immediately got charged $245! Fraudulent and misleading at every click!!!

reviews.title: Not worth the subscription
reviews.text:
To pay $180 for something I could find on YouTube for free was disappointing. I was really expecting a greater number of topics and experts. 

I got this as a gift and did not instead to use it after the disappointment. It auto renewed my account with no warning and charged my credit card.  There is no refund for cancelled accounts (not even partial refunds). Not only that but deleting your account does not stop auto renewal. Make sure you read the fine print of every email because it’s a 1000 step process to get out of this subscription. 

This product is not worth the money at all!!

reviews.title: Scan
reviews.text: Sneaked into a renewal. Refused to refund. Kept telling me I need to give them code to refund from an email they sent that never arrived. Awful.

reviews.title: Unprofessional
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with how MasterClass handled my account and would not recommend the service based on my experience.

I signed up and paid $60 in good faith during the Labor Day promotion. I successfully used the app for approximately a week, so there was clearly an active account associated with my purchase. Then, suddenly, I was told that my account could not be located.

What followed was even more frustrating. Instead of someone investigating what happened to an account I had already paid for and been actively using, I received very little meaningful communication. Eventually, my $60 was simply refunded. There was no real explanation of how my account disappeared, no attempt to restore my access, and no meaningful follow-up.

What concerns me most is the outcome. I purchased the service during a promotion, that promotional purchase is now gone, and if I wanted to rejoin I would have to pay a higher price. I cannot say whether that was intentional, but from a customer perspective it is incredibly troubling.

After looking online, I also found other customer complaints involving MasterClass being unable to locate paid accounts or associated email addresses, along with numerous complaints about billing and customer service issues. That makes my experience even more concerning.

I paid for the service in good faith. I did not ask to cancel it. I wanted the account I purchased and had already been using. Instead, the company refunded me and effectively ended the rel

reviews.title: Great content - terrible app
reviews.text: There is great content here but the app is so user unfriendly, its such a shame. Pages get stuck, you cant download a whole class but need to do individual episodes, app is laggy, real shame, want to see more courses, just get discouraged to do so

reviews.title: Great classes - Support sucks though
reviews.text: If you go to sign up, I hope you don’t encounter any glitches. I had an issue where I made an account and paid and it launched me into the app but didn’t carry the information over so I had to sign up again and got double charged. When I went to their support team for help, I only had the option to chat with an AI bot. The only other option was through email. I wanted to get this resolved as quickly as possible and communicating through email is not preferred. The AI was no help so now I’ve had to file a claim with my bank. How annoying.

reviews.title: Would not buy again
reviews.text: A little deceptive. The add offered a video that I was interested in. After purchase discovered that most the content that suited me had to be purchased separately. Kind of a bummer. But I’ll remain open minded perhaps some good will come from it.

reviews.title: Terribly useless
reviews.text: This app always makes me create duplicate accounts to pay double for the plus membership even though I already have the one. I will stop subscribing this app to save my meaningless time to login the app every time.

reviews.title: $$$$ bill you after canceling !
reviews.text: After canceling they bill you $180 on a Friday.  Call your bank and dispute charges.

reviews.title: The app is terrible for screen mirroring
reviews.text: I try to mirror this to my tv and it never works right and I can’t control it from my phone

reviews.title: RIP OFF Unable to Cancel
reviews.text: I have tried everywhere to cancel my subscription, but they do not list it anywhere.  They just charged my account for another year.

reviews.title: No substance
reviews.text: These classes are just for celebrity lovers. Don’t purchase if you’d actually like to learn a skill.

reviews.title: Master of none
reviews.text: Just a bunch of celebrities trying to earn a quick buck don’t waste your coin!

reviews.title: App is Majorly Flawed
reviews.text: The development team really needs to work on how it authenticates users. There is so much unnecessary friction built into the process. It’s easier to access a bank account than videos I’m entitled to due to my subscription payment. I will probably cancel my subscription simply due to how clunky the app is. I have to use a web browser to access my account right now.

reviews.title: Issues with content and functionality
reviews.text: I am disappointed in the quality of content on the app. The information in the classes is very surface level. Ive completed probably 10 classes don’t have a better understanding of the subject matter than I did before the class using just common sense and human experience. But probably more frustrating is the app functionality. It is the only app I have that overheats my phone, even on audio only mode. I regularly stream video from several other apps without a problem. The app also freezes often, has a significant navigation delay, and the screen display becomes distorted. There is no excuse for an app with such a high annual fee to have so many technical issues. I’ve been using it for months hoping these issues were just glitches that would resolve and they have not.

reviews.title: Gift
reviews.text: I received a membership as a gift December 25, 2025. I utilized it a little back then. I tried to sign in today and my only option was to pay for a new membership. I would like to take a couple of courses but I don’t want to pay again for the gift I was given. This seems like a bait and switch.

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Classes are good… app is horrible!! It’s slow to load, if it loads at all. It doesn’t remember what you’ve already seen in an episode, difficult to use UI. It’s painful to use. I think I’ll stick to the desktop, which isn’t great either tbh

reviews.title: Avoid! You can never log in and have to wait days to be able to.
reviews.text: Brought a yearly subscription and barely used the app due to the continuous hassle of logging in. You go through customer service via email, and it's a case of back and forth until finally being able to log in.  Totally regret signing up to this app as lessons and glasses could be found on Youtube for free and with minimal hassle!

reviews.title: Harassment
reviews.text: Keeps trying to charge a credit card that is canceled despite trying to cancel my subscription. They attempt to charge this card literally every couple of days.

reviews.title: App failure
reviews.text: What is the point of having the ability to download classes if one is not able to play them without being connected to WiFi or internet?

reviews.title: App has gone downhill
reviews.text:
The app no longer shows trailers to the classes. So, you can’t get an idea if you want to watch them or not. 
Masterclass is great infotainment. But, the app isn’t great and the website keeps trying to direct you to the app instead of letting you navigate the courses. I’ll be canceling my subscription if they don’t fix the app soon.

reviews.title: You can’t cancel.
reviews.text: To cancel it says got to the website and support.  You can’t do it on app.  When you go to the website  it loops to a page asking. To edit profiles and no way to cancel.   What a scam.

reviews.title: Too many barriers to cancel
reviews.text: To cancel or turn off automatic renewals, you must do it on a desktop. This has ended up costing me so much money for this app that I never use. I used it for a couple of things when it started, but couldn’t figure out how to cancel it. Some of this is my fault for forgetting when I was around my desktop. Why can’t they make it easy to cancel on the app? Customer support has been no help. I caught the renewal a little bit outside of the window available for a refund and now I have ended up paying for a year for an app I don’t use.

reviews.title: Content aside the app is terrible
reviews.text: Glitchy app and it quits on its own… sometimes doesn’t even open. Also it doesn’t let you delete things from your progress list

reviews.title: Not available
reviews.text: I paid for the course, and now it's unavailable. And the report a problem button just gives an error. I can't even contact support.

reviews.title: Don’t do it
reviews.text: I got charged and didn’t even approve of any charges. I just now asked for a refund $180 and they “can’t find me” in their system. I sent screenshots from my bank statement showing the charges. I gave them everything they need to find me and they still can’t find me.  And they won’t give me a number for customer service… none listed on the website either… this is definitely a scam

reviews.title: Horrible Tech Supoort
reviews.text:
There is a big issue in getting the add-on through ipad/iphone/ app/web/vpn/no vpn (UAE market).

The team was NOT proactive in solving the issue. I spent three days troubleshooting on my own. All they do - is sending emails with sorry for your issue. 

Thats it!!! No tech help whatsoever. 

Terrible customer service/aftersales.

reviews.title: Tech needs improvement, content is great
reviews.text:
Happy to fix my reviews with updates to the app.

The content of MasterClass is really good, and the people that have found to interview has been really amazing. Although I will say that some of the initial people that they picked and had classes that were much more insightful than the recent ones. No dig at anybody’s credentials of the recent courses, but somehow it just feels that the amount of effort was put in coming up with extremely insightful knowledge on the recent courses as there was in the courses. And it is not the length of the course that determines that.

As for the app, it’s quite disappointing to be honest. The branding is really good, really appreciate the UX and the colors and everything. The issue is with the billing process of it, it takes over 24 hours for changes to be shown. Somehow the tech in the backend is not integrated well enough. But today’s technology and AI coding available they should be super easy to solve.

The most frustrating thing though is on the mobile phone app when we go into the audio only mode. Somehow, when you do that with Apple Music or Spotify. To switch between working on the phone or locking your phone and everything keeps playing. But that’s not the case with MasterClass app. It stops every chance it gets, it stops that every notification that comes through even though priority notifications. And then to get it back up and going, it’s also very slow. It also stops when the audio output device changes where is Apple Music on

reviews.title: App overheats phone
reviews.text: The content is good but the app is useless. It’s the only app on my phone where when I open it, the phone instantly starts overheating and after using it for just a few minutes I have to kill the app and take the case off to cool it down. Both the front glass and back of the phone (even thru the case!) are physically hot to touch. Just to test this when the phone was normal cool temperature I closed all other apps, opened just the masterclass app, and sure enough within a few minutes it was quite hot to touch. I have a 15Pro. I haven’t pushed it to the limit to see if the phone will shut off because it’s physically uncomfortable to handle so I just close the app and therefore it’s useless for more than 5 minutes at a time.

reviews.title: Don’t gift this to people
reviews.text: I got a year subscription as a “gift.”Not much of a gift because it still wants your credit card and makes it set up to automatically renew. Normally that would be ok if you could pre-cancel and have access for the remainder of your year. But no, you can only cancel and lose your access immediately. It’s pretty clear their product actually sucks because why else would you need to be so shady to ensure people keep their subscription after a year? So please DO NOT GIVE THIS TO PEOPLE AS A GIFT

reviews.title: Billing
reviews.text: While they advertise their pricing as a monthly rate, you must pay for the entire year upfront. Not easy to cancel.

reviews.title: The worst app ever
reviews.text: I’m not sure how this app is rated so high. It loses previously downloaded classes. It fails to load things correctly 80% of the time, it is organized/designed poorly. The interface will fail to load properly half the time. It crashes mid video a lot. I pay a lot for a masterclass subscription and this is the app they produce/maintain. Atrocious!!!!

reviews.title: So so content, terrible app
reviews.text: Content is average at best. They seem to truncate everything down and gloss over many topics, which leaves a lot of knowledge gaps and prevents the content from being as actionable as it should be.  Almost seems like they the programs are just a preview or advertisement for the speaker’s book, separate course, etc. App meanwhile is terrible. Super glitchy, often doesn’t save my progress, hard to navigate, many programs are not categorized appropriately and when I am searching the library, a previous course that I started will just randomly start playing full blast. Play and pause buttons can’t even function on a consistent basis. I have subscriptions to numerous similar apps - MindValley, Coursera, Heroic, etc. All are far better.

reviews.title: Additional fees for class resources
reviews.text: Made the previously included class resources an additional fee. I pay for a membership but I can’t access the class resources unless I pay an additional fee. The resources used to be included in the regular membership. Greedy business. Membership cancelled.

reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.text: There’s not a lot of real business options. This is mostly for industry people and it’s more opinion based. I didn’t feel like I was learning a lot. I thought I canceled my renewal but it renewed anyway. I can’t get a refund even though I  haven’t logged into the app since the first year. Not worth the cost.

reviews.title: Useless offline
reviews.text: The app won’t open unless you have a 4G/5G signal, making the download function totally useless. If I’m travelling or going somewhere with no data signal, I download courses to watch but can’t even get the app open. Furthermore, the courses downloaded will just un-download randomly. It’s so frustrating and makes the app unusable without a strong data signal.

reviews.title: Can’t login via google on iPad
Auto-Renewal
reviews.text: Somehow they took my money without it being in my Apple subscriptions.

reviews.title: Not for everyone, obviously. But…
reviews.text: There’s another annoyance… you cannot stream, mirror, airplay or whatever else you may have unless is a google cast device. Yes I am serious. That’s stupid. Not everyone wants to watch all this material in a tiny little screen and not everyone has a Google Cast.

reviews.title: Good Content - Bad App
reviews.text: The app is really bad. It auto plays when you login and it’s hard to navigate. Worst of all for me though is that it heats up my phone and kills my battery. Lost 25% battery life in 30 minutes. Phone was crazy hot. Their website clearly had. 30 day money back guarantee. If they give me the run-around I’ll just dispute it with the credit card company.

reviews.title: Good luck cancelling
reviews.text: The app doesn’t support cancelling your subscription. Lock in that gives subscriptions a bad wrap.

reviews.title: Don’t get stuck paying for this
reviews.text: This is just another subscription service that wants you to pay and forget that you’re on an automated renewal. I haven’t logged in for 6 months. They charged me for an annual subscription one year after I signed up to try it. I reached out IMMEDIATELY after they charged me and asked for a refund. After fighting with them they are only willing to refund 50% (but I get to keep using it for 6 months…whoopie!). I haven’t logged in for 6 months, what makes you think I’m going to start now. They don’t have many useful classes. They could have refunded the full thing but they are greedy.

reviews.title: Offline issues
reviews.text:
So we have a download feature that I can’t see that works. You can’t even run the app in the first place unless you have mobile data on. So waste of time downloading a few courses for a long flight. 

Then once running. Downloaded content Doest run if you turn data off. So burnt a lot of data while abroad. Even though I have several GBs of data taken from phone storage.

Content is ok. Quite obvious ideas/concepts from what I’ve seen so far. But well produced and clear.

reviews.title: Not what it seems
reviews.text:
Slow glitchy app, short, mediocre content.  

Cancellation extremely difficult.  Thought I cancelled this months ago.  Can’t access content so assumed cancellation went through but got billed again. 

Customer support initially responds then ghosts you.  Offered discount then stopped responding.  

Honestly surprised at the lack of customer service with an App this pricey.

reviews.title: They need to work on this app, not designed well
reviews.text: There’s a lot of little issues they need to work on this app. For the last 15 minutes, I’ve been just trying to get to the previous video of one of the episodes and it’s not easy to use. I highlighted three courses I wanted to take and they don’t seem to be getting saved anywhere so I have to look them up every time.

reviews.title: Honestly useless
reviews.text: Short videos with good edits to seem valuable but you can save money and watch it on YouTube

reviews.title: DO NOT UPGRADE IN-APP
reviews.text: Masterclass’s content is phenomenal. That is not what this review is about. It is about the fact that you cannot download content on the “standard” subscription, learning this only after purchase and being forced to upgrade to “Duo” subscription for $179.99, the  the upgrade never being applied to the account. If you download this app DO NOT subscribe via in-app purchase. ONLY do it through masterclass website. The customer support is hot AI garbage. I’ve spent days trying to get my account fixed to simply get what I paid for. Still no luck.

reviews.title: User interface is trash
reviews.text: The User interface is trash. Often can’t even find my progress on and browsing is bad

reviews.title: Very difficult to cancel
reviews.text: The content is great, it’s pricey because of those who are offering these classes.  I wanted to cancel because of the price and they have made it very difficult to cancel a subscription.   There is not an option to cancel within the app, but they make it very easy to delete your account (which does NOT cancel your subscription) which removes access to the account so even though you have just paid for a subscription, you no longer get to use the app. How is this legal?

reviews.title: the 5 star reviews are all ai
reviews.text: dont listen to the 5 star reviews, it's just a chat bot.

reviews.title: Money Scam
reviews.text: Mediocre content at best, learn nothing useful. They will get you in, then hide your subscription from your list of Apple subscriptions. You’ll forgot you have it, and then they will renew your subscription for twice the amount and refuse to refund you the money. And that’s after you spent several hours figuring out how to contact anytime at MasterCheats.

reviews.title: Good content. Bad apps.
reviews.text: The content is good and interesting. The Apps, both iPhone and Apple TV are really cumbersome. There are a bunch of things that they are trying to use other methods than the usual way of working on Apple devices and it makes it super cumbersome. Each time it’s so challenging to find out how to do some simple things. Some things I can only do in the iPhone App and some things only in the TV App which is so stupid to have to switch back and forth … also dumb little simple thing, their profile picture upload isn’t working properly. Kind of simple, good example of the rest of things not working correctly.

reviews.title: Worthless App
reviews.text: Cancelled them MONTHS ago after having purchased a year’s worth, because it’s a complete waste of money. Deleted it from my apps. Thought it was history. But today they charged me for an annual renewal. Can’t cancel again because they aren’t downloaded on my phone anymore. Having to go through my bank to cancel the fraudulent charge.

reviews.title: Masterfees
reviews.text: An app that offers no value, directs to their website, and has a reeeeeally generic and fake “Editors Choice” that has somehow lasted years 😂 what a sad scam

reviews.title: Love the classes, but app is buggy
reviews.text: I enjoy the classes and there’s a great variety and content added often, but the app is terrible to use. Very buggy, I have to force close it often. Also, the UX needs a lot of improvement. I don’t want a video to automatically start when I open the app, it would be nice to have a conclusion at the end of the series to know it’s done when I’m just listening and not watching, the navigation between videos and class pages need to be better, amongst other things.

reviews.title: Good content, horrendous app
reviews.text: On iPad, the app is slow to open and you have to click the buttons multiple times before anything happens. Downloading classes is painful. There is no way to download all the lessons at once, you have to download each lesson individually. Downloading also runs into errors sometimes, but all you get is a question mark.

reviews.title: Log in
reviews.text: Logging in is a real problem

reviews.title: Remove Peter Attia
reviews.text: Peter Attia is a mandated reporter and as a physician has failed his greatest moral responsibility. His content should be removed from your platform. I would like my money refunded if his course will remain on your platform.

reviews.title: Garbage classes, garbage company
reviews.text: The classes are what they are, if you need famous people telling you platitudes go nuts. But the app sucks, it’s impenetrable. And the company is worse, scammers through and through. Just trying to cancel is impossible, and they will keep attempting to charge your card long after you’ve told them to stop. I have inquired with my payment processor about legal steps to get them to stop.

reviews.title: Not as good as it used to be
reviews.text:
A few years ago, the classes were more comprehensive, giving you a deeper dive into the subject matter that felt more like taking a class—often complete with supplemental material. 

A lot of the recently added “classes” are just a single 1-hour lecture. Feels more like a general overview than an actual class. I also do not appreciate their use of AI animations. Rather than hiring an animator, licensing stock footage, or filming actors (all of which would pay human beings for the content they create), it feels like MasterClass is cutting corners with AI slop to keep the costs down. 

The result is a product that feels cheaper and less inspired than it used to be.

reviews.title: Poor customer experience
reviews.text: Required to enter a credit card to access a GIFT! Ridiculous. Presumptive. Arrogant.

reviews.title: DONT WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY-Predatory billing practices
reviews.text:
I had ordered a year subscription to masterclass in 2024 and without reading fine print was unaware that I would be billed again the following year- and a higher rate at that. After I was billed I found that there was no forgiveness for this and masterclass does not allow refund of payment if you forget. Fine- I figured out the NOT straight forward or easy way to cancel my subscription via their website and concluded that I would make the best of the money I paid already(that over-drafted my bank account).
Now they are claiming I don’t have an account connected to my email and I cannot access material without resubscribing. And when I try to contact them via help I am met with extremely unhelpful AI. 

Do yourself a favor- DONT SUBSCRIBE. The content is meh anyway. You can find their videos on YouTube for free- or better yet MORE INFORMATIVE CONTENT. Save yourself the insane price and hassle.

reviews.title: Masterclass in Extortion
reviews.text: Low quality videos that do nothing to educate you. You will drop it in a week then get slapped with a lovely $200 renewal when you forget to cancel with no hope of a refund for a product you never used. Good luck

reviews.title: App constantly locking up
reviews.text: Good content, even though some is quite pedestrian. Why does the app constantly lock up and freeze when I’m listening on my locked iphone? I’m open the phone, go to the app and the I have to force quote and restart the app. This happens so much so may ask for a refund. The hassle isn’t worth access to the content.

reviews.title: Beware of Auto-Renew
reviews.text: I received a Materclass subscription as gift in 2024, and now have been charged $191 the past two years for a service I have not used since the initial gift subscription expired. Searching my inbox, junk & trash email turned up NO invoice for the initial renewal charge in 2025, and it’s been so long since I used the service, I thought the invoice I just received was a phishing scam. So, if you are considering gifting a Masterclass subscription to someone heed this warning, as it may ultimately cost you that relationship.

reviews.title: Currently unusable app
reviews.text:
The app doesn’t accept my login credentials that I confirmed are correct on the website. When I restarted my phone and reinstalled the app, I logged in online, and opened the app, and it was a black screen with a gray bar at the bottom. Nothing else loaded. 
Separately, when the app was working the suggestions upon opening the app were generic and not tailored to what I took the time to say I was interested in. They also never changed in the month that I was able to use the app successfully.

reviews.title: Buggy App
reviews.text: I’m loving the content - having a hard time listening in audio mode on my commute. Every time I come back to the app in the morning or evening, the app doesn’t remember my progress and insists on starting the content from the beginning. So frustrating! I hope it gets updated soon!

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: The app is awful, there is no way to back out of the video player so you have to kill the app if you need to back out. It constantly auto resumes videos when I don’t want. And courses I’ve saved often don’t show up in my list. Finding specific courses in their catalogue is frustrating.

reviews.title: Frustrating app
reviews.text:
The app keeps on autoplaying videos (and yes it is set to off). Very annoying. 

Regarding the content, the jury is still out. The concept is interesting but it seems to be mostly ego projects.

reviews.title: No notice on renewal
reviews.text: The app auto renewals without any notice. I have asked for a cancellation the same day of the renewal and the bot is telling me it isn’t possible. Hopefully masterclass will do the right thing and if so, I will delete or update.

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: App only works if connected to WiFi. I bought the app so I could listen during my walks . I wasted my money. I spend my entire walk watching the cursor spin until I get an error message. Save your money unless you plan to only listen at home while connected to WiFi. Kind of defeats the purpose of a mobile app.

reviews.title: The App is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: This app is absolutely HORRIBLE!  Paid for a subscription that I never use - all because of the horrible app. You can’t contact anyone, because in the app (that is horrible) it says there is no email associated with the subscription - even though it is clearly showing my email. Terrible service and even worse app.

reviews.title: Still exploring
reviews.text:
First class I listened to: Levar Burton, “The power of storytelling.”
Thinking I am going to learn something about telling stories.
A lot of personal opinions. A lot of racial charged ideas. Some good pointers about storytelling and a couple good children stories read. 

Not really a class. Some of the best sections, in content, have “um” fillers. Not great for storytelling.

I will to watch two other classes and will not cancel right away. 

Two stars because sound and image are good. The problem is with the content.

reviews.title: horrible customer service/experience canceling account
reviews.text: I requested my account be deleted on 12/23/2025. I say “requested” because users can’t just delete their account; you have to initiate the deletion process. On 12/28/2025 — 5 days after attempting to delete my account — I was charged $180. I was told by customer service that my account hadn’t yet been deleted and that refunds are not provided under these circumstances.

reviews.title: Remove background music
reviews.text:
Please update the app to have an option to either reduce or completely remove the background music. For an adhd and special needs person it’s almost impossible to listen to the content and understand what the speaker of trying to say with such loud interferring background music. I don’t  believe that for such an expensive app to expect such a basic feature in this advanced world of AI is asking to much. The content may be great but unfortunately I am
unable to grasp anything

reviews.title: Why so much Kim
reviews.text: This app is not easy to navigate.  Over promote things I have no interest in. Hard to just resume where you were.  Poor controls when casting.  Overall not a great app.

reviews.title: Sneaky renewal policy, mediocre content
reviews.text:
I found this app disappointing and borderline deceptive. The ads are classic clickbait—promising depth and transformation but delivering very little substance. Most of the instructors come across as self-important and spend more time repeating vague truisms than actually teaching anything practical or actionable.

To make matters worse, the subscription auto-renews without adequate notice. That alone is enough to erode trust, especially when paired with marketing that already feels misleading. Overall, this app prioritizes hype and ego over genuine learning value. I would not recommend it.

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Service
reviews.text: This has been the WORST experience. Your website clearly crashed and there is no support to resolve this problem. My pregnant wife is crying and nobody can make this right. We are going to lose this promotion and am going to post on social media.

reviews.title: Auto Renewal
reviews.text: We were set up on monthly payments then at the end of the first year they decided to switch us to the yearly plan with no notice and charged the full years amount.

reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text: Way too expensive for what it is ! Look around and you’ll find the same information for free! It is very disappointing. The concept is good but the content is very poor. When i started i was really excited then disappointment took over fast.
